items.body: What initially prompted Fernando to embrace Islam?

options.label: A personal spiritual experience.
An academic comparison of religious texts.
Influence from Muslim friends.
A desire to join a specific community.

prompt.body: Which specific aspect of the Quran’s preservation convinced Fernando of its authenticity?

options.label: Its poetic beauty and linguistic style.
The unification of manuscripts across multiple languages in the 7th century.
The historical accuracy of its prophecies.
The moral teachings aligned with his personal values.

prompt.body: How does the Quran’s preservation challenge the historical transmission of the Christian apocrypha?

options.label: The Quran explicitly refutes apocryphal texts.
The apocrypha were excluded from canonical texts due to inconsistencies, unlike the Quran’s unified transmission.
The Quran was written earlier than the apocrypha.
The apocrypha were preserved in fewer languages than the Quran.

prompt.body: The apocrypha are religious texts that were not included in the official Bible or Jewish scriptures. Fernando studied these texts and compared them to the Quran, which led him to embrace Islam.

items.body: After hearing Fernando’s story, how confident do you feel in your ability to stand firm in your beliefs when faced with opposition?

options.label: Anger
Betrayal

items.body: Reflect on a time when you witnessed someone from your own community not standing up for what’s right. How did that make you feel?
What consistent action does Fernando take to combat Islamophobia in his community?

options.label: Organizing protests against Islamophobia.
Running a food pantry for all demographics.
Teaching Islamic studies at local schools.
Leading interfaith dialogues with Christian leaders.

prompt.body: How does Fernando’s approach to serving the Hispanic community specifically address misconceptions about Islam?

options.label: By providing Spanish-language Islamic literature.
By greeting them in Spanish and acting as a relatable bridge.
By inviting them to mosque events.
By debating their religious beliefs directly.

prompt.body: What long-term impact might Fernando’s consistent service have on the perception of Islam in his community?

options.label: It may create a lasting positive association with Islam through action rather than words.
It will likely lead to mass conversions in the Hispanic community.
It will eliminate Islamophobia entirely in his area.
It will primarily benefit the Muslim community rather than non-Muslims.

prompt.body: Fernando runs a food pantry every Saturday, serving anyone in need regardless of their background. This action helps combat Islamophobia by showing the positive impact of Muslims in the community.
